name: Hetzner DNS
description: Sends DNS zones to Hetzner DNS with the Hetzner Cloud API. The panel keeps the records, and the plugin makes the zone at Hetzner the same after each change.

credentials.label: API token
credentials.hint: An API token of the Hetzner Cloud project of your DNS zones, with the permission Read & Write. Make it in Hetzner Console, in Security > API tokens.
